import math
import unittest

from solution import build_report, cubic_score, verify_scores


class NumericFunctionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_cubic_score(self):
        self.assertEqual(cubic_score(0), 7)
        self.assertEqual(cubic_score(2), 15)
        self.assertEqual(cubic_score(-2), -1)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(cubic_score(0.5), 5.25)

    def test_cubic_score_rejects_invalid_scalars(self):
        for value in [True, False, "2", None, float("nan"), float("inf"), float("-inf")]:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    cubic_score(value)

    def test_build_report_values(self):
        report = build_report(7, 3, [1, 2, 3], (4, -1, 2), math.pi / 4)
        self.assertEqual(
            set(report),
            {"true_quotient", "floor_quotient", "remainder", "dot_product", "sine", "cosine", "tangent"},
        )
        self.assertEqual(report["true_quotient"], 7 / 3)
        self.assertEqual(report["floor_quotient"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(report["remainder"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(report["dot_product"], 8)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(report["sine"], math.sqrt(2) / 2)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(report["cosine"], math.sqrt(2) / 2)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(report["tangent"], 1.0)

    def test_negative_division_uses_python_semantics(self):
        report = build_report(-7, 3, [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0], 0)
        self.assertEqual(report["floor_quotient"], -3)
        self.assertEqual(report["remainder"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(report["true_quotient"], -7 / 3)

    def test_build_report_is_fresh(self):
        first = build_report(4, 2, [1, 0, 0], [2, 0, 0], 0)
        first["dot_product"] = 999
        second = build_report(4, 2, [1, 0, 0], [2, 0, 0], 0)
        self.assertEqual(second["dot_product"], 2)

    def test_build_report_rejects_zero_and_invalid_scalars(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_report(1, 0, [1, 2, 3], [1, 2, 3], 0)
        invalid = [True, "1", None, float("nan"), float("inf")]
        for value in invalid:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    build_report(value, 1, [1, 2, 3], [1, 2, 3], 0)
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    build_report(1, value, [1, 2, 3], [1, 2, 3], 0)
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    build_report(1, 1, [1, 2, 3], [1, 2, 3], value)

    def test_build_report_rejects_bad_vectors(self):
        bad_vectors = [None, [1, 2], [1, 2, 3, 4], [1, "2", 3], [1, float("nan"), 3], "123"]
        for vector in bad_vectors:
            with self.subTest(vector=vector):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    build_report(1, 1, vector, [1, 2, 3], 0)
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    build_report(1, 1, [1, 2, 3], vector, 0)

    def test_verify_scores_with_lists_and_generators(self):
        values = (value for value in [-2, 0, 2])
        expected = (value for value in [-1, 7, 15])
        self.assertEqual(verify_scores(values, expected), [True, True, True])
        self.assertEqual(verify_scores([0, 1], [7, 999]), [True, False])
        self.assertEqual(verify_scores([], []), [])

    def test_verify_scores_does_not_mutate_inputs(self):
        values = [0, 1, 2]
        expected = [7, 5, 15]
        values_copy = list(values)
        expected_copy = list(expected)
        verify_scores(values, expected)
        self.assertEqual(values, values_copy)
        self.assertEqual(expected, expected_copy)

    def test_verify_scores_validation(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            verify_scores([1], [5, 6])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            verify_scores(None, [])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            verify_scores([], None)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            verify_scores([True], [5])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            verify_scores([1], [float("nan")])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            verify_scores([float("inf")], [1])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
